text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the best race I am currently capable of.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't afford to be idle.
A flaw was found in my theory, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Should I rather return to the initial step
and reconstruct a different theory...?
It feels a shame to discard all our theories up to now. But... should I support the runner's own wishes?
It feels a shame to discard all our theories up to now. But... should I support the runner's own wishes?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you
for respecting the theories I've built up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... There is meaning in both failure and success.
Nothing is ever entirely wasted.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright! First, let's identify the theories that worked well.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With everything I have,
I will leap toward the formula for victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now, while the memory of the race is still fresh, is the perfect chance to reconstruct my theory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's head straight back to the academy...
Oops, I'll need to buy some bananas on the way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"That replenishes the sugar needed to keep one's mind sharp.
It is an absolute necessity for long, drawn-out meetings."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be clear, it's not simply
because I want to eat it, understood?
Afterward, Biwa Hayahide and I stocked up on bananas at the greengrocer's... and stayed up late reviewing the race.
